lines.en: label mayafestival4:
scene hanabi1
When was the last time you felt alive?
lines.zh: 你上一次觉得自己还活着是什么时候？

lines.en: Because in this moment, I feel more alive than I have in a very, very long time.
lines.zh: 因为此刻，我觉得自己比这很长、很长一段时间以来都要鲜活。

lines.en: Something about how small everything looks from all the way over in this unknown part of the world makes even breathing exciting.
lines.zh: 从世界这个未知的角落望出去，一切都显得那么渺小，这一点让连呼吸都变得令人兴奋。

lines.en: I time my inhalations to match the explosions in the sky.
lines.zh: 我把吸气的时间对准天空中的爆响。

lines.en: My lungs hate me for it, but my heart has hated me for much longer.
lines.zh: 我的肺会因此恨我，但我的心恨我已经恨得久得多。

lines.en: Pretty soon, every last organ in my body will give up on me.
lines.zh: 用不了多久，我身体里每一个器官都会弃我而去。

lines.en: I’ll be left decaying in a bed somewhere, wondering why I didn’t take more time to appreciate moments like this.
lines.zh: 我会在某张床上慢慢腐烂，想着为什么当初没有多花点时间去珍惜这样的时刻。

lines.en: I hope that wherever that bed is, there’s a window.
lines.zh: 我希望那张床所在的地方有一扇窗。

lines.en: And I hope that the view from it will be even half as nice as this one.
lines.zh: 也希望窗外的景色能有这里的一半好。

lines.en: I wonder if she ever saw anything like this.
lines.zh: 我不知道她有没有见过这样的东西。

lines.en: I wonder if she’d appreciate it as much as I do.
lines.zh: 我不知道她会不会像我一样珍惜它。

lines.en: : I feel bad for the people living directly underneath all this.
lines.zh: : 我真替就住在这一切正下方的人感到难过。

lines.en: : It’s nice from up here, but I can’t say I’d be very happy if there were fireworks above my house periodically throughout the year.
lines.zh: : 从上面看是很美，但我可不敢说，如果一年到头时不时就有烟花在我家屋顶上炸开，我会很高兴。

lines.en: : I’m surprised they’re even doing something like this over here.
lines.zh: : 我挺惊讶他们居然会在这种地方放烟花。

lines.en: : It looks like they’re being lit off in that forest over there.
lines.zh: : 看起来是在那边的树林里点的。

lines.en: : Do you have a sudden interest in fire prevention or something?
lines.zh: : 你突然对防火感兴趣了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : There’s nowhere else to light them off around here.
lines.zh: : 这附近也没别的地方可以放。

lines.en: : It’s not as if they can be set off over a lake or river when the closest bodies of water are miles away.
lines.zh: : 最近的水体都在几英里外，总不能把烟花架在湖上或河上放吧。

lines.en: : Oh well. Sucks for everyone trying to get some sleep right now, I guess.
lines.zh: : 唉。那现在想睡觉的人就倒霉了，我猜。

lines.en: : It certainly does. We’ll just have to continue enjoying this at the expense of everyone below us.
lines.zh: : 确实。我们只能继续享受这一切，代价由下面所有人承担。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say, this seems like a pretty high budget affair for a part of Kumon-mi no one really travels to.
lines.zh: : 我得说，对于 Kumon-mi 一个没人会来的地方来说，这场面预算还挺高的。

lines.en: : Fireworks are relatively inexpensive. And, from what I understand, all of the lanterns and stalls were put together by the people still living here.
lines.zh: : 烟花相对不贵。而且据我所知，所有的灯笼和摊位都是还住在这儿的人自己搭起来的。

lines.en: : And the six thousand vendors we bought food from?
lines.zh: : 那我们买过东西的那六千家摊贩呢？

lines.en: : Individually funded, I assume. I’m sure there were some vendors from the other districts too.
lines.zh: : 大概是各自出资吧。我猜也有从别的区过来的摊贩。

lines.en: : Does this district have a name?
lines.zh: : 这个区有名字吗？

lines.en: : If it does, I don’t want to know it.
lines.zh: : 如果有，我也不想知道。

lines.en: : Why does everything always have to be a mystery with you?
lines.zh: : 为什么什么事到了你这儿都得是个谜？

lines.en: : Because the only thing worse than being stuck in one place for all eternity is being stuck in one place and knowing everything about it.
lines.zh: : 因为比永远被困在一个地方更糟的，就是被困在一个地方，还对它了如指掌。

lines.en: : Missing details give me more to think about.
lines.zh: : 缺失的细节能让我多点东西可想。

lines.en: : No wonder why you’ve been smiling so much lately.
lines.zh: : 难怪你最近笑得这么多。

lines.en: : Yes, it’s quite nice being able to do that in between the incessant bouts of emotional turmoil and mental strain.
lines.zh: : 是啊，能在无休止的情绪动荡和精神紧绷之间挤出点笑容，感觉相当不错。

lines.en: : At least you can relax now.
lines.zh: : 至少你现在可以放松了。

lines.en: : How unfortunate that an entire village must suffer for it.
lines.zh: : 可惜的是，得有一整村的人为此受苦。

lines.en: scene hanabi2
The fireworks don’t let up. But, in between the bursts of light, we can still hear the chatter from the festival below.
lines.zh: 烟花没有停歇。但在光芒炸开的间隙，我们仍能听见下方祭典的喧闹。

lines.en: It seems that the later it gets, the more people show up.
lines.zh: 似乎天越晚，来的人越多。

lines.en: And while plenty of them seem focused on tonight’s display, there are plenty others who don’t.
lines.zh: 虽然有不少人专注于今晚的表演，但也有相当多的人不是。

lines.en: There’s even a surprising amount of men here- something I haven’t been able to say in...I guess what would be the equivalent of about a year in recycled time.
lines.zh: 这儿甚至还有数量惊人的男人——这话我已经有……大概相当于循环时间里的一年没说过了。

lines.en: Maybe two?
lines.zh: 也许两年？

lines.en: I’ve stopped keeping track of how long it takes for anything to happen here.
lines.zh: 我已经不再去记这里发生任何事要花多久了。

lines.en: There’s just no point to it when you know that all clocks have stopped rotating in any meaningful way.
lines.zh: 既然你知道所有的钟都已经不再以任何有意义的方式转动，记它也就没有意义了。

lines.en: Surprisingly enough, I don’t hate the voices from below.
lines.zh: 出乎意料的是，我并不讨厌下面传来的声音。

lines.en: It’s hard to put it into words, but even this wide array of loud, intrusive noises feels incredibly quiet atop this hill.
lines.zh: 很难用语言表达，但即便是在这样一片嘈杂、扰人的声音里，站在这座小山顶上也觉得异常安静。

lines.en: Occasionally, a gust of wind will attack us from behind in an attempt to distract us from gazing too long at something neither of us deserve to see, but we pay it no mind- for we’ve already spent all we have.
lines.zh: 偶尔会有一阵风从背后袭来，试图分散我们的注意力，不让我们凝视太久那些我们两人都不配看见的东西，但我们毫不在意——因为我们早已花光了所有。

lines.en: That’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: Neither one of us has anything left to spare.
lines.zh: 我们两个都没有任何余裕了。

lines.en: : Can I interrupt this moment to be cliche once again?
lines.zh: : 我能不能再打断一下这个瞬间，说句老套的话？

lines.en: : Sure. Just don’t put your hand in front of my face when you raise it up to the sky to measure stars or whatever. I’m actually enjoying watching these.
lines.zh: : 说吧。只是别在把手举向天空量星星还是什么的时把你的手挡在我脸前。我是真的在享受看这些。

lines.en: : I won’t.
lines.zh: : 不会的。

lines.en: : It’s just that, as the resident astronomy expert of our make-believe manga, I’m obligated to tell you the story of Altair and Vega at least once before the series concludes.
lines.zh: : 只是作为我们这部虚构漫画的驻场天文专家，在系列完结前，我至少得给你讲一次 Altair 和 Vega 的故事。

lines.en: : That’s fine. You’ve gone the entire day without talking about the stars.
lines.zh: : 行。你一整天都没聊过星星。

lines.en: : I yield the floor to you now as a reward for your good behavior.
lines.zh: : 现在我把发言权交给你，作为你表现良好的奖励。

lines.en: : Vega- or Alpha Lyra, which is the fifth brightest star in the entire sky...was said to be some sort of celestial princess according to Chinese mythology.
lines.zh: : Vega——也就是天琴座α，全天第五亮的恒星……在中国神话里，据说是某位天上的公主。

lines.en: : Under the impression she’d be alone for all eternity, Vega began to lose hope and grew depressed.
lines.zh: : 因为觉得自己会永远孤身一人，Vega 渐渐失去了希望，变得消沉。

lines.en: : But, one day, a random mortal by the name of Altair showed up and Vega thought, “You know what? Fuck it. I’m lonely and this is the best I can find.”
lines.zh: : 但有一天，一个名叫 Altair 的普通凡人出现了，Vega 想：“管他呢。我很孤独，而这已经是我能找到的最好的了。”

lines.en: : I feel like every other iteration of this story I’ve heard has started off a little more romantic.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我以前听过的其他版本，开头都浪漫一点。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, sometimes it doesn’t really work that way.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧，有时候事情就是不是那样的。

lines.en: : Anyway, as Vega and Altair began to spend more time together, the two of them gradually started to fall in love- even though she was significantly better than him in every way.
lines.zh: : 总之，随着 Vega 和 Altair 相处的时间越来越多，两人渐渐坠入爱河——尽管她在方方面面都比他强得多。

lines.en: : Vega promised Altair that, no matter what happened, the two of them would always be together. And since she was a goddess of the sky, Altair knew she meant business.
lines.zh: : Vega 向 Altair 承诺，无论发生什么，两人永远都会在一起。而既然她是天上的女神，Altair 知道她说的是认真的。

lines.en: : But when Vega’s father found out about this, he got extremely pissed off.
lines.zh: : 可当 Vega 的父亲发现这件事时，他气极了。

lines.en: : It was one thing for Altair to be mortal- but hearing that his daughter promised a seemingly eternal life in the heavens to her lover...saying Vega’s father was infuriated would be a bit of an understatement.
lines.zh: : Altair 是凡人已经够让人头疼了——但听说自己的女儿向情人许诺了看似永恒的天上生活……说 Vega 的父亲勃然大怒都有点轻描淡写了。

lines.en: : In a fit of passive aggressive rage, he used his power to grant Vega’s wish- but in the worst way possible.
lines.zh: : 在一阵消极攻击式的暴怒中，他用自己的力量实现了 Vega 的愿望——却是以最糟糕的方式。

lines.en: : The two of them were placed into the sky as stars, but separated by the Milky Way.
lines.zh: : 两人被化作星星放上了天空，却被银河隔开。

lines.en: : They were together in a technical sense, but as far apart as possible.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说他们是在一起了，却又隔着尽可能远的距离。

lines.en: : But every year, on the seventh night of the seventh moon, a bridge would form across the Milky Way...and Altair would cross over to meet his lover.
lines.zh: : 但每年，在第七个月的第七夜，银河上会架起一座桥……Altair 便能跨过去与爱人相会。

lines.en: : One night every year, the two of them could be together.
lines.zh: : 一年只有一个晚上，他们两个能在一起。

lines.en: : But once the night would come to an end-
lines.zh: : 可一旦那个夜晚走到尽头——

lines.en: : You don’t have to tell me how the story ends. I already know it.
lines.zh: : 你不用告诉我故事的结局。我已经知道了。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s too sad anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说了，那也太伤感了。

lines.en: : Here’s hoping that Altair and Vega can stay together this year and have tons of white-hot, celestial star sex with each other.
lines.zh: : 那就祝愿 Altair 和 Vega 今年能待在一起，好好来上一场白热化的、天上的星星性爱吧。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : You’re a nerd.
lines.zh: : 你真是个书呆子。

lines.en: scene hanabi3
: Does-
: Don’t talk. You’ll just ruin everything.
lines.zh: : 别说话。你只会把一切都毁了。

lines.en: : Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: Maya rests her head upon my shoulder. And while I can’t see her face, I can feel the smile count increase by one.
lines.zh: Maya 把头靠在我肩上。虽然我看不见她的脸，但我能感觉到微笑计数又加了一。

lines.en: We meet on the other side of a bridge of magpies and, for just one night, detach ourselves from the rules that govern us every other day of the year.
lines.zh: 我们在鹊桥的另一端相会，只在这一夜里，从那些一年中其余每一天都束缚着我们的规则里脱身。

lines.en: Or at least that’s what we would do if we were stars.
lines.zh: 至少如果我们是星星的话，就会是这样。

lines.en: But neither one of us is anywhere near bright enough to come close to one of those.
lines.zh: 可我们两个都远不够亮，离那种东西还差得远。

lines.en: And even if, by some strange twist of fate, we were placed in the night sky along those same lights Maya dedicates at least ten hours a week to staring at-
lines.zh: 而且就算命运奇妙地转折，我们被放上夜空，与 Maya 每周至少花十小时盯着看的那些光同列——

lines.en: Even if that were to happen, I doubt the Milky Way could keep me from her.
lines.zh: 就算真有那种事，我怀疑银河也拦不住我靠近她。

lines.en: I like annoying her far too much to let something like that get in the way.
lines.zh: 我太喜欢惹她生气了，不会让那种东西碍事。

lines.en: The two of us may share some connections to those literal star-crossed lovers, Altair and Vega-
lines.zh: 我们两个或许和那对名副其实的星运多舛的恋人 Altair 与 Vega 有些共通之处——

lines.en: But we’re our own creatures.
lines.zh: 但我们是我们自己的造物。

lines.en: And there’s a high likelihood that there are other creatures looking up at us from somewhere underneath-
lines.zh: 而且很有可能，正有别的造物在某处下方仰望着我们——

lines.en: And that they’ll hand down stories about us for generations and generations, despite how depressing or unfortunate they may be.
lines.zh: 而它们会把我们的故事一代又一代地传下去，不管那些故事有多伤感、多不幸。

lines.en: Hopefully, the stars can hear their story one day.
lines.zh: 希望有一天，星星们能听见它们的故事。

lines.en: : Why did you tense up just now?
lines.zh: : 你刚才为什么突然绷紧了？

lines.en: : I just had some really immature, star-related thought that you would probably think is cute.
lines.zh: : 我只是想到了一个非常幼稚、和星星有关的念头，你大概会觉得它很可爱。

lines.en: : Don’t share it. You and cute don’t belong in the same room together.
lines.zh: : 别说出来。“你”和“可爱”不该出现在同一个房间里。

lines.en: : I guess that defeats any chance of us ending up at a love hotel tonight, then.
lines.zh: : 那看来我们今晚是没可能去爱情旅馆了。

lines.en: : As if that chance ever existed in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那种可能性从一开始就不存在。

lines.en: : I feel like it did.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它存在过。

lines.en: : Or does.
lines.zh: : 或者现在存在。

lines.en: : I feel like-
lines.zh: : 我觉得——

lines.en: : Shut up and watch the fireworks.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，看烟花。

lines.en: : The grand finale is close.
lines.zh: : 压轴表演快到了。

lines.en: : I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 我感觉得到。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

The sky!
lines.zh: 天空！

lines.en: An egg, an egg- what’s in an egg?
lines.zh: 一颗蛋，一颗蛋——蛋里有什么？

lines.en: A chicken?
lines.zh: 一只鸡？

lines.en: A duck?
lines.zh: 一只鸭子？

lines.en: Another white egg?
lines.zh: 另一颗白色的蛋？

lines.en: Maya’s hands find their way to mine.
lines.zh: Maya 的手找到了我的手。

lines.en: They fuse together into one larger hand.
lines.zh: 它们融合成了一只更大的手。

lines.en: scene hanabi6
////////////////HAND SUCCESSFULLY ADDED
lines.zh: ////////////////HAND SUCCESSFULLY ADDED

lines.en: : I had a dream that I was flying.
lines.zh: : 我做了个梦，梦见自己在飞。

lines.en: : You were there, but it wasn’t actually you.
lines.zh: : 你在那儿，但那其实不是你。

lines.en: : We were on the roof. The same room. At different times. The same place.
lines.zh: : 我们在天台上。同一个房间。不同的时间。同一个地方。

lines.en: : The sky turned black and I felt a bubble begin to form underneath my forearm.
lines.zh: : 天空变成了黑色，我感觉到前臂底下开始鼓起一个泡泡。

lines.en: : You approached me and helped me pop it.
lines.zh: : 你走过来，帮我把它弄破了。

lines.en: scene hanabi7
: From out of the bubble oozed a thick, yellow liquid.
lines.zh: : 从泡泡里渗出了一种浓稠的黄色液体。

lines.en: : You lapped it up like a cat and told me that we would be better for it.
lines.zh: : 你像猫一样把它舔干净，然后告诉我，这样对我们俩都好。

lines.en: : I never forgot the sensation of that bubble popping. Or the tip of your tongue as it explored the inside of my arm.
lines.zh: : 我永远忘不了那个泡泡破裂的感觉。也忘不了你的舌尖探进我手臂内侧的触感。

lines.en: scene hanabi8
I knew right then that it was egg time.
lines.zh: 我当时就知道，是时候吃蛋了。

lines.en: The hard-ish but not that hard white oval in my hand, reminiscent of holding a half-complete baseball- where the insides are all messed up and confusing when unwound.
lines.zh: 我手里那个硬邦邦但又没那么硬的白色椭圆，让人想起握着一只做了一半的棒球——拆开之后里面全都乱七八糟、令人困惑。

lines.en: Have you ever egg before?
lines.zh: 你吃过蛋吗？

lines.en: I would not recommend it unless you are ready.
lines.zh: 除非你准备好了，否则我不建议。

lines.en: Sometimes, people think they can egg when they can’t.
lines.zh: 有时候，人们以为自己能吃蛋，其实不能。

lines.en: Then, before you know it-
lines.zh: 然后，在你意识到之前——

lines.en: scene hanabi9
Squid!
lines.zh: 鱿鱼！

lines.en: But why squid?
lines.zh: 可为什么是鱿鱼？

lines.en: This is second time squid show up in special Maya event chain! Not understand!
lines.zh: 这是鱿鱼第二次出现在 Maya 的特别事件链里！不明白！

lines.en: Me teach.
lines.zh: 我来教。

lines.en: scene hanabi10
Everything in the waters that has fins and scales, whether in the seas or in the rivers, you may eat.
lines.zh: 水中一切有鳍有鳞的，无论是在海里还是在河里，你们都可以吃。

lines.en: But anything in the seas or the rivers that has not fins and scales, of the swarming creatures in the waters and of the living creatures that are in the waters, is detestable to you.
lines.zh: 但凡在海里或河里、无鳍无鳞的，无论是水中成群滋生的，还是水中各样活物，对你们都是可憎的。

lines.en: You shall regard them as detestable; you shall not eat any of their flesh, and you shall detest their carcasses.
lines.zh: 你们要把它当作可憎之物，不可吃它的肉，连它的尸体也要当作可憎。

lines.en: Everything in the waters that has not fins and scales is detestable to you.
lines.zh: 水中一切无鳍无鳞的，对你们都是可憎的。

lines.en: This is my word.
lines.zh: 这是我的话。

lines.en: Egg is okay, though.
lines.zh: 不过蛋是可以的。

lines.en: scene hanabi1
: Oh, I forgot.
lines.zh: : 哦，我忘了。

lines.en: : I got something for you.
lines.zh: : 我给你带了点东西。

lines.en: : For me?
lines.zh: : 给我的？

lines.en: scene hanabi11
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : I figured that it would be best to uphold this tradition as well, given my hesitancy when it comes to accepting change.
lines.zh: : 我想，既然我在接受改变这件事上这么犹豫，那还是把这个传统也保持下去比较好。

lines.en: : What is it?
lines.zh: : 是什么？

lines.en: scene hanabi11x
: A box.
lines.zh: : 一个盒子。

lines.en: : I don't have it with me.
lines.zh: : 我没带在身上。

lines.en: : In fact, it's not really a present at all. I just need your help carrying it.
lines.zh: : 事实上，它根本算不上礼物。我只是需要你帮我搬。

lines.en: : Am I at least allowed to know what’s in it this time?
lines.zh: : 这次我至少能知道里面是什么吗？

lines.en: scene hanabi12
: Only if you can open it.
lines.zh: : 只要你打得开。

lines.en: : In the event that you can’t-
lines.zh: : 万一你打不开——

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Wait, are you okay? You feel...ten degrees colder all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 等等，你还好吗？你突然……好像冷了十度。

lines.en: : Is...everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一……切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Everything is okay.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。

lines.en: scene hanabi4
: Everything is okay.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : Then, if you’re okay with it-
lines.zh: : 那么，如果你不介意的话——

lines.en: scene hanabi13
: I’d like to stop by both my dorm room and the school once we’re done here.
lines.zh: : 等这边结束之后，我想顺路去一下我的宿舍和学校。

lines.en: : It’s a little cold to be wearing a yukata anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正穿浴衣也确实有点冷了。

lines.en: : I figured it would stay warm for a little longer.
lines.zh: : 我原以为还能再暖和一阵子。

lines.en: : What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : We won’t have time to play if you don’t hurry up and help me finish here.
lines.zh: : 你要是不赶紧帮我把这儿弄完，我们就没时间玩了。

lines.en: : Yes. It is too cold for a yukata.
lines.zh: : 是的。穿浴衣太冷了。

lines.en: : Yukata? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 浴衣？你在说什么？

lines.en: scene hanabi4
: Do you ever feel yourself coming unglued?
lines.zh: : 你有没有感觉自己正在一点点散架？

lines.en: : How much skin comes off as you peel yourself to freedom?
lines.zh: : 当你把自己剥向自由时，掉下来多少皮？

lines.en: scene hanabi14
: One very large banana!
lines.zh: 一根非常大的香蕉！

lines.en: scene hanabi15
: Come on! Take the picture already!
lines.zh: : 快点！赶紧拍照啊！

lines.en: : We ain’t got all day, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我们可没一整天的时间，Sensei！

lines.en: : Yeah, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 就是啊，Sensei！

lines.en: : Y-Yeah, Sensei! What are you waiting for?!
lines.zh: : 就、就是啊，Sensei！你还在等什么？！

lines.en: : What are you waiting for?
lines.zh: : 你还在等什么？

lines.en: : What the fuck are you waiting for?
lines.zh: : 你他妈的还在等什么？

lines.en: : What the fuck are you waiting for?
lines.zh: : 你他妈的还在等什么？

lines.en: scene hanabi16
: Huh?
: What are you waiting for?
lines.zh: : 你还在等什么？

lines.en: : You’ve been holding that box and staring into space for about a minute now.
lines.zh: : 你已经抱着那个盒子、盯着空气发呆大概一分钟了。

lines.en: : Weren’t...
lines.zh: : 我们不是……

lines.en: : Weren't we just at the festival?
lines.zh: : 我们不是刚刚还在祭典上吗？

lines.en: : If by just you mean like two hours ago, yes.
lines.zh: : 如果你说的“刚刚”是指大概两小时前，那是的。

lines.en: scene hanabi17
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Is it happening again?
lines.zh: : 又来了吗？

lines.en: : Is what-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: : Are you blacking out?
lines.zh: : 你在断片吗？

lines.en: : Dreaming?
lines.zh: : 在做梦？

lines.en: : What’s going on? I can’t help you if I don’t know what it is- and you’ve seemed fine this whole time.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你不说我就帮不了你——而且你这一整晚看起来都挺好的。

lines.en: : I don’t feel fine.
lines.zh: : 我感觉不好。

lines.en: scene hanabi18
: I’d like to assume it’s just because you’re tired, but something tells me that would be far too convenient.
lines.zh: : 我想假设那只是因为你累了，但有种直觉告诉我，那未免太省事了。

lines.en: : Do you want to, like...lay down? Or go home?
lines.zh: : 你想不想……躺一下？或者回家？

lines.en: : We don’t have to do this tonight. There’s still time.
lines.zh: : 我们不必非得今晚做。还有时间。

lines.en: : No. We can do it now.
lines.zh: : 不。现在就可以做。

lines.en: : You wanted to spend the whole day with me, so...
lines.zh: : 你本来想跟我待一整天，所以……

lines.en: : Yeah, but it’s already the next day, so...
lines.zh: : 是啊，可现在已经是第二天了，所以……

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. If I’m able to hold a conversation with you now, the worst of it is probably over.
lines.zh: : 我会没事的。如果我现在还能跟你对话，那最糟的部分大概已经过去了。

lines.en: scene hanabi19
: Well, good. Because I hate having to carry that thing on my own.
lines.zh: : 那就好。因为我可不想自己扛那玩意儿。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : You carry enough as it is.
lines.zh: : 你已经扛得够多了。

lines.en: scene black
I carry a box.
lines.zh: 我扛着一个盒子。

lines.en: I have a sudden craving for eggs.
lines.zh: 我突然很想吃蛋。

lines.zh: ////////////////MAYA EVENT COMPLETE

lines.zh: ////////////////THERE ARE NO MORE MAYA EVENTS IN CHAPTER 2
